name: MEP Coordination — Clash Judge
description: Takes an IFC model, finds true clashes and clearance violations in MEP services, triages by congestion and programme, and proposes sourced resolutions on a clone. The original model is never written to.
author: bopoadz-del

standalone.note: Built kit-first so extraction to a standalone product is a manifest change, not a rewrite. No code depends on the construction container.

NEVER: writes to the original IFC model or any authoring tool
proposes a move that cannot be sourced to a rule without flagging it unsourced
reports an element with no geometry as clear

requires.note: manifold3d supplies the boolean backend. Without it the engine degrades to surface intersection and says so in every finding.
